g.text: Advanced-node logic wafers, consumed and as a share of supply

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: What it shows: Epoch AI's published figure at both of its "show data as" settings — advanced-node logic wafer consumption

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: by the 4 tracked AI chip designers (NVIDIA, Google, Amazon, AMD) in each quarter, as an amount and as a share of world

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: supply. Q1 2024 to Q4 2025, the full window the source covers.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Source: Epoch AI, AI Chip Components (CC-BY) — quarterly_by_designer.csv + supply_denominators.csv — epoch.ai/data/ai-chip-components

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Methodology: Derivation follows Epoch AI's published AI Chip Components methodology; every figure is a Monte Carlo median over 10,000 draws

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: Logic wafers are 12-inch 3-5 nm wafers fabricated at TSMC (N3/N5 class), which become the silicon dies inside AI accelerators. Share

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: is of total world supply of the component, not of AI demand: the five bars sum to exactly 100% of the quarterly denominator Epoch

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: publishes, and the identity was checked to 3e-14 percentage points. "Other" is therefore not a fifth AI chip designer but the

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: residual of that denominator - capacity taken by designers Epoch does not track, stockpiling, idle capacity, or error in the tracked

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: estimates. Epoch itself calls it directional. The dashed line on the left panel is that same denominator, so the two panels are the

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: same quantity read two ways. Every value is a Monte Carlo median; the published 5th-95th percentile range is wide and is charted

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: separately in CHIP-D04. 3 designer rows for the partial quarter after the window are excluded.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #ffffff

g.text: COMPLETE QUARTERS ONLY · partial Q1 2026 excluded
